title: docattest configuration
description: Configuration file (docattest.config.json) for docattest: documentation that CI can fail.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor validation and completion.

pages.description: Globs of Markdown or MDX pages to check. Gitignored files are never pages, and globs cannot start with '!': use frozen to leave pages out.

adapter.description: Language adapter name (such as "typescript", "python", "go", "rust", or "none" for core-only checks without a language runtime). Defaults to "none" when omitted.

surfaces.description: Public API surfaces by name. Optional when pages only use manifests, files, snapshots, console blocks, citations, or standalone examples.

frozen.description: Globs of pages listed in the report but never parsed or checked (e.g. changelogs, historical ADRs).

prose.description: Globs of living pages with nothing to prove: still checked and audited, but counted apart rather than as uncovered.

sources.description: Globs of source files whose doc-comment examples are checked.

setup.description: Module or package providing cases runners and named facts.

snapshots.description: Settings for pinned external snapshots read by snapshot("name").

dir.description: Directory holding snapshot files, relative to the project root.

maxAgeDays.description: Age in days after which a snapshot is reported as stale.

runtime.description: Execution limits for running examples, facts and cases.

timeoutMs.description: Per-block, per-fact or per-row time budget in milliseconds.

workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent workers. Defaults to one per CPU.

ignoreTags.description: Extra fence info-string words added by a docs renderer (such as "twoslash") that docattest accepts and ignores.

members.description: Subdirectories holding nested docattest projects checked together with this one.

commands.description: Programs executed by console check blocks mapped to globs of the source files they are built from, used by impact.

undocumented.description: Per-surface globs of exported symbol names intentionally left undocumented.

internal.description: Mark a surface as internal/fact-only so facts can read its symbols without counting it in public API coverage or uncovered.
